interviewPrep.architectureWalkthrough: The system is a 6-stage LangGraph pipeline: Ingest (normalizes JSON), Classify (LLM categorizes failures), Ground (Tool-calling reads code), Tribunal (Proposer/Challenger agents diagnose), Evals (Generates regression tests), and Debrief (Writes customer memo). It uses a checkpointer to enable human-in-the-loop interrupts before the remediation phase.
